metadata.methods_description: Data were collected using a time-synchronized multimodal sensor suite recording both members of a dyad simultaneously via Lab Streaming Layer (LSL), producing one .xdf recording per session. Modalities include BioSemi high-density scalp EEG (512 Hz, one session at 2048 Hz), 43-channel EMG neckband, ECG/EOG/auxiliary channels, PhaseSpace motion capture (480 Hz) plus avatar pose (50 Hz), head-mounted eye-tracking, AMTI force plate physio, Xbox controller behavioral data, and SNAP task marker event timelines, later converted to BIDS format.
